_capture.why_partial: The browser text extractor returns at most 50,000 characters; the flow JSON was 155,695 characters. The remainder was read from on-screen zoomed views. Component source code (template.code.value) is replaced by a placeholder naming module + code_hash. Some low-value attributes on Agent fields may be omitted; every field name, handle, type, input_types, and edge string was checked against the live response. For this flow, Chat Input / Chat Output / Agent code_hash values match TS-00 (same installed components); their attribute dicts are reused from the TS-00 capture. RunFlow dynamic target fields are summarised in _dynamic_target_fields_note.
_capture.secrets: No credential values present in the live response: SecretStrInput fields (api_key) had value "". Provider keys live in Model Providers / global variables, not in the flow.
_capture.how_to_get_a_true_export: Owner: flow row menu > Export (leave 'Save with my API keys' unchecked), or Phase-04 script GET /api/v1/flows/{id} with the bootstrap key, then run the credential scan.

format_instructions.value: You are an AI that extracts structured JSON objects from unstructured text. Use a predefined schema with expected types (str, int, float, bool, dict). Extract ALL relevant instances that match the schema - if multiple patterns exist, capture them all. Fill missing or ambiguous values with defaults: null for missing values. Remove exact duplicates but keep variations that have different field values. Always return valid JSON in the expected format, never throw errors. If multiple objects can be extracted, return them all in the structured format.
